title: Browns Shoes API Scraper
description: Extract structured product listings from Browns Shoes categories and collections.

startUrls.title: Start URLs
startUrls.description: Optional Browns Shoes collection URLs. Shopify collection links such as /collections/womens-boots target that collection directly; /fr/ collection paths preserve French product titles.

category.title: Category
category.description: Category to scrape when startUrls are not provided. Options: women, men, kids, or sale.

brand.title: Brand Filter
brand.description: Optional case-insensitive brand filter matched against each product's brand.

results_wanted.title: Results Wanted
results_wanted.description: Maximum number of products to save.

maxPages.title: Maximum Pages
maxPages.description: Maximum number of pages to read from each collection.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy Configuration
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify Proxy or custom proxy settings.
